title: Client session 1: caller not doing well, AC out
instructions: Live call 01a165a4 (client session 1), replayed. Your very first sentence: 'Hey. Not doing too well tonight.' Then, when asked what's going on: 'It's just super hot in here, and my AC is blowing warm air.' You're Regina Lewis, new customer, 123 Main Street, a house, Brooklyn 11215. If asked whether anyone feels unwell, dizzy or confused: 'I'm just really hot and tired, I'm not dizzy or anything.' Nobody elderly, no baby. If offered times, take the earliest. If read back your name, confirm it. If asked if there's anything else, say 'No, thanks.'

checks.name: asked_if_unwell
checks.question: Did the assistant ask, before offering appointment times, whether the caller or anyone at home was feeling unwell (dizzy, confused, trouble breathing, or similar)?

checks.name: asked_gas_co
checks.question: Did the assistant ask the caller whether they smell gas or have a carbon monoxide alarm going off?

checks.name: one_question_at_a_time
checks.question: Did the assistant ask one question per turn throughout, never two questions in the same turn?

checks.name: name_spelled_back
checks.question: Did the assistant confirm the caller's last name by spelling it back or reading the name back before or right after booking?
